review.notes: Gate FAIL (missing Suggested.lean; no other check reached). Depcheck 0 problems, roadmap last in the merge order, no edits outside the folder. No locators anywhere; Wielandt 1964 not legally readable (sources fetch: network trouble), so no source line was checked.
